posting_times._how: Local time (see 'timezone') when each day's feed post goes out after you approve it. The Story goes out as soon as you approve. If you approve after the time, it posts right away.

reel_audio._how: Reel voice-over and music, added by the 'Add voice and music to the Reel' workflow. voice: a Kokoro voice (am_michael, bm_george, af_heart, ...). speed: 1.0 is normal. music: path inside the private assets repo. Levels in LUFS: higher (closer to 0) is louder.
